title: The Handful of Auctions That Ended Souq.com's eBay Years
conflicts: What the auctions were worth: The National (Jan 2011) reported few auction sales and about 5,000 auctions against 120,000 listings, while Entrepreneur Middle East (2017) called the closed auction and classifieds services 'fairly significant generators of both traffic and revenue'; both given with attribution. Arabian Business's reported '80 per cent of revenue in one night' quote is behind a 403 and was left out. Amazon price undisclosed: $580m (Arab News, Africanews) against about $650m (FT via Entrepreneur Middle East); both given.
notes: Retry succeeded: Mouchawar's own account comes from The National (2 January 2011, quoting him on 12 months of analysis and deciding after a handful of auctions closed in November 2010), his emailed statement in The Next Web (5 January 2011), and later interviews (The National 2015, Entrepreneur Middle East 2017, Arab News 2022). The slate year 2005 is the founding; the episode is the end of 2010 into 2011. Quote stance: affirms.
